title.zh: S&P Global backs Kaiko as Series B reaches $110M
title.en: S&P Global backs Kaiko as Series B reaches $110M

current_state.zh: S&P Global led a strategic investment in crypto market data provider Kaiko, extending its Series B to $110 million with backing from major banks and exchanges to build data infrastructure for tokenized securities and onchain financial markets.
